verdict.rationale: Meltano's pricing page explicitly states 'Reverse ETL included' and touts 600+ connectors plus general EL(T) capability to move data between systems, suggesting the underlying capability exists, but there is no documentation, connector list, or hands-on account showing how modeled warehouse data is synced back into specific SaaS tools like CRM/ads/support platforms. Missing for 10: named reverse-ETL connectors/destinations, setup guide for warehouse-to-SaaS sync, and independent/community confirmation of this workflow in practice.
